Name: aiChooseUCS
Signature: function aiChooseUCS(plays,idx){let best=plays[0],bs=-9999;for(const p of plays){let s=0;const isDraw=p.c.val==='d2'||p.c.val==='w4';const isSpecial=p.c.val==='skip'||p.c.val==='rev';const isWild=p.c.col==='w';if(isDraw)s+=60;if(isSpecial)s+=30;if(isWild&&plays.filter(x=>x.c.col!=='w').length>0)s-=40;if(G.pendingDraw>0&&isDraw)s+=100;s+=(Math.random()-.5)*2;if(s>bs){bs=s;best=p;}}return best;}
